# GANs vs the supervised U-Net, unseen people (generated by scripts/gans.py)

Test data: each development person's 'late' part, scored once per seed by the fold that holds the person out. Seeded rows are averaged over seeds per person first. unet and avg_beat are the models of results/simple_models and results/baselines, rescored here with the beat-shape metrics.

## Person-by-person, Pearson r

- pix2pix_adv0.1 vs unet: pix2pix_adv0.1 better for 7 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.001; Wilcoxon p = 0.528
- pix2pix_adv0.1 vs avg_beat: pix2pix_adv0.1 better for 13 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.245; Wilcoxon p = 0.00269
- pix2pix_adv1 vs unet: pix2pix_adv1 better for 4 of 16 people; mean r difference -0.024; Wilcoxon p = 0.0934
- pix2pix_adv1 vs avg_beat: pix2pix_adv1 better for 14 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.220; Wilcoxon p = 0.00516
- cycle_paired vs unet: cycle_paired better for 4 of 16 people; mean r difference -0.004; Wilcoxon p = 0.433
- cycle_paired vs avg_beat: cycle_paired better for 14 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.240; Wilcoxon p = 0.00101
- cycle_unpaired vs unet: cycle_unpaired better for 1 of 16 people; mean r difference -0.494; Wilcoxon p = 0.00058
- cycle_unpaired vs avg_beat: cycle_unpaired better for 2 of 16 people; mean r difference -0.250; Wilcoxon p = 0.025
- cgan_2g6d vs unet: cgan_2g6d better for 6 of 16 people; mean r difference -0.012; Wilcoxon p = 0.375
- cgan_2g6d vs avg_beat: cgan_2g6d better for 14 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.232; Wilcoxon p = 0.00214

## How much is a time shift? (lags.csv)

For each person, the constant shift of the output (within +-200 ms) that maximises r, averaged over seeds; positive = output late. r_best_lag is r after that shift: the shape skill left once timing is corrected by hand (an upper bound, since the shift is chosen on the test data).

| method         |   r_lag0 |   r_best_lag |   median_abs_lag_ms |
|:---------------|---------:|-------------:|--------------------:|
| cgan_2g6d      |    0.605 |        0.756 |               5.667 |
| cycle_paired   |    0.612 |        0.757 |               6.333 |
| cycle_unpaired |    0.122 |        0.654 |              47.333 |
| pix2pix_adv0.1 |    0.617 |        0.75  |               5.333 |
| unet           |    0.616 |        0.753 |               5.333 |

Beat-shape metrics (scg2ecg/metrics.py: morphology) are cut at the database's R-peak marks: template_r = average output beat vs average real beat; beat_r = median per-beat correlation; r_amp_ratio = output R amplitude / real (below 1: flattened beats; timing errors also lower it).
Training histories: histories.csv (487 epochs).
